verdicts.reason: A breaks the logo lockup apart: the chef hat is blown up to a huge white blob floating top-left, the cleaver and spatula are scattered small over the busy radish garnish, and the cloche and 'BBQ PARTY' are shrunk off to the right with a stray red line fragment, so the brand mark and hierarchy are destroyed. B keeps the hat/tools/cloche lockup whole, centred and well scaled so the headline dominates, as in the original. Its only flaws are minor: 'BBQ PARTY' still runs slightly past the dome edges and the photo crop is a bit tighter.
